name: FableVision
description: Custom-spawn Seed Finder (Create World → ✨): describe the spawn you want, or pick a structure + biome, and real seeds are searched with the game's own world-gen — you spawn normally, nothing is placed. Schematic auto-builder (/build): .schem/.litematic/.schematic/.nbt with textured ghost previews, paid block-by-block from a real chest — survival-fair, singleplayer only. Ask AI about your screen (press G) with your own Gemini/GPT/Claude/Groq key. Plus crystal PvP vision tweaks (low fire/shield, fullbright, no explosion particles, AppleSkin-style food HUD) and LAN + Bedrock hosting via Geyser (/client lan). /client opens the menu.
